# Class: `FreezeEventComboBox`

Captures the selection context when an event dropdown or keyboard action begins.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-event-navigation.md) · [Source](../src/icescopy_event_navigation.py#L7) · [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `QComboBox`.

Internal `QComboBox` subclass owned by `FreezeEventSelector`. It refreshes available events before interaction and retains the context used to reject an activation after the cell, frame source, event records, or cycle assignments change.
